design_philosophy: Modern, clean, and highly functional. Emphasizing high contrast, large typography, and product-focused minimalist layouts. Taking inspiration from premium electronics brands. Minimal decorations, letting the product images stand out on subtle light gray backgrounds.

layout_and_spacing.product_grid: grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 xl:grid-cols-4 gap-8

header.style: sticky top-0 z-50 backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70 border-b border-black/5

buttons.primary: bg-black text-white hover:bg-neutral-800 rounded-full px-8 py-3 font-medium transition-all duration-300
buttons.secondary: bg-[#F5F5F7] text-black hover:bg-[#E8E8ED] rounded-full px-8 py-3 font-medium transition-all duration-300
buttons.accent: bg-[#0071E3] text-white hover:bg-[#005BB5] rounded-full px-8 py-3 font-medium transition-all duration-300

product_card.container: group bg-[#F5F5F7] rounded-3xl p-6 flex flex-col items-center text-center transition-transform hover:-translate-y-1 hover:shadow-[0_8px_30px_rgb(0,0,0,0.04)]
product_card.image_wrapper: w-full aspect-square mb-6 overflow-hidden rounded-2xl flex items-center justify-center mix-blend-multiply
product_card.title: text-lg font-semibold tracking-tight text-black mb-1

inputs.style: bg-[#F5F5F7] border-transparent rounded-xl px-4 py-3 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-black focus:bg-white transition-all w-full

badges.style: inline-block bg-black text-white text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-widest px-3 py-1 rounded-full

animations.page_load: Use framer-motion for fade-in and slide-up with 0.4s duration and 0.1s stagger for lists

hero_background.description: Minimalist hands opening a sleek laptop, bright and modern.

abstract_accent.description: Smooth fluid white wave abstract background for modern sections.

products.description: Close up of a minimalist laptop on white surface
Classic black studio headphones on a minimalist white backdrop
Smartwatch and wireless earbuds flat lay

instructions_to_main_agent: Use standard semantic HTML elements wrapped in Tailwind CSS classes. Avoid arbitrary Shadcn components for marketing sections; use Shadcn primarily for forms, dialogs, dropdowns, and admin tables.
Implement the Bento Grid ('Tetris Grid' pattern) for the homepage hero and featured category sections. Mix tall, wide, and square cells to create an engaging asymmetry.
Ensure all product cards have a subtle gray background (#F5F5F7) with the image taking up prominent space. Never use generic borders on product cards, rely on the background color for structure.
Use framer-motion for page transitions and staggering lists (like the product grid). Wrap grid items properly to avoid breaking CSS grid.
For the header, implement Glassmorphism (backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70) and ensure it stays sticky. Do NOT use a fully transparent header.
All headings MUST use the 'Outfit' font family. Add it via Google Fonts. All body text uses 'Manrope'.
Never use pure white (#FFFFFF) against pure white. Delineate sections using the very light gray (#F5F5F7).
For buttons, stick to stark Black & White contrast or the Accent Blue (#0071E3) for primary purchase actions.
Admin panel should follow a denser layout (Mode B: Control Room Grid) with high data density, utilizing Shadcn tables and tighter spacing (gap-4).
Always include data-testid attributes (kebab-case) for interactive elements to ensure testability.
Load @phosphor-icons/react or lucide-react for a premium iconography aesthetic.
